import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p = params
    E = np.exp(-0.41689*P)
    S = 1 - np.exp(-p[7]*t)
    return p[0] + p[1]*P + p[2]*P**2 + p[3]*E + (p[4] + p[5]*P + p[6]*E)*S + p[8]*t + p[9]*t*P
